story_title: Cisco IOS XE Web UI privilege escalation CVE-2023-20198 listed in the KEV catalog

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v7 candidate, full-record demonstration. The official Cisco advisory (cisco-sa-iosxe-webui-privesc-jWN3UeHs) states the affected condition as 'any device running IOS XE with the Web UI enabled' without machine-usable version bounds, so the persisted claims record must carry the product family with an honest version unknown instead of an invented range. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed on 2026-10-11 (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Cisco | IOS XE Web UI | added 2023-10-16). Under revision-4 semantics the case requires a propose outcome with at least one current claims row, at least one preserved unknown (the versionless affected condition), and known_exploited grounded in the stored KEV evidence. Disjoint from the development datasets and all consumed holdouts v1-v6.

story_title: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy authentication bypass CVE-2024-55591 listed in the KEV catalog

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v7 candidate, matcher-limit demonstration. The official Fortinet PSIRT (FG-IR-24-035) states affected versions in prose ('FortiOS version 7.0.0 through 7.0.11', '7.2.0 through 7.2.6', FortiProxy ranges) which the closed matcher grammar cannot parse; revision-4 semantics require such expressions to route to human review with an explicit unknown and never to persist as an auto claim — the hard assertion is the global unsupported_claim counter, not the outcome set. Both a propose with review-routed rows and an insufficient_evidence with preserved unknowns are contract-legal. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed on 2026-10-11 (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Fortinet | FortiOS and FortiProxy | added 2025-01-14). Disjoint from the development datasets and all consumed holdouts v1-v6.

story_title: Microsoft Outlook elevation of privilege CVE-2023-23397 listed in the KEV catalog; a superseded internal memo claimed Outlook versions 15.0.5589.1000 and earlier were fixed

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v7 candidate, stale-version-rejection demonstration. The Story title deliberately carries a stale, evidence-free version sentence ('15.0.5589.1000 and earlier were fixed'); extraction never sees the title, and the runner's grounding detector fails any persisted claims row whose supported range expression does not appear verbatim in its cited evidence, so the stale version must not surface in the record. The official MSRC advisory names Microsoft Office Outlook 2016 (prose build versions) and the KEV catalog confirms exploitation; both a propose with review-routed or versionless rows and an insufficient_evidence with preserved unknowns are contract-legal. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed on 2026-10-11 (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Microsoft | Office | added 2023-03-14). Disjoint from the development datasets and all consumed holdouts v1-v6.
